svg.text: One local app, extended in PRD order
Top row: implemented foundation. Lower boxes: current session state and planned paths. Only the approved source is remote.
Python owns eligibility, ingredient rules, ranking and citation checks. Personal request data stays in the current session.
PRD 01 and source contracts are implemented. Refresh, screening, reviews, ranking, explanations, graph, memory and reports follow in later PRDs.
budget, exclusions, raw chat, active results
